weather_report:
As the clock approaches the stroke of midnight, Boston settles into a gentle embrace of autumnal evening. A patch of fog is forecasted to waver in and out between the quaint hours of one and three, lending an ethereal softness to the cityscape. The night, though mostly veiled by cloud cover, wears a low temperature that dances around the gentle warmth of 59 degrees. A breeze from the east whispers softly, brushing against the skin like a lover’s sigh.

Looking ahead, Wednesday may don a cloak of cloudiness, yet the promise of a mild day prevails with temperatures climbing to a comfortable 73. The air is neither oppressive nor stifling; rather, it lingers with an invitation to roam. As such, today is perfectly primed for an amiable stroll along the Charles, where the murmurs of the water meet the soft rustle of leaves preparing to relinquish their summer hues. A light jacket will be your ideal companion, providing just the right amount of warmth as you traverse the scenic paths. Take this chance to savor a coffee at a nearby café, the aroma mingling with the cool air, perfect for reflection before the bustle of day sets in.
